parameters.content:
05_Error_Logs — central error logging + rolling 3-month retention

PATH A (real-time): On Workflow Error -> Build Log Row -> Append Log (Realtime)
PATH B (daily n8n-API backfill): DISABLED per request. Kept for reference; needs
  an n8n API credential to re-enable.
PATH C (daily retention): Daily 03:00 -> Read Logs -> Plan Deletions -> Delete
  Old Rows. Keeps only a rolling last-3-months window (deletes rows > 90 days).
MANUAL BACKFILL (one-time): Backfill Now (Manual) -> Historical Rows -> Append
  Log (Historical). Pre-loaded with this project's collectable error history.

LOG COLUMNS: timestamp | workflow_name | node_name | error_code
  | error_description | execution_id | source

SETUP: Logs tab lives in the Media spreadsheet. To receive real-time errors,
  set THIS workflow as the Error Workflow on 01-04 after publishing 05.
